name: Löptin (Germany)
description: White field with two columns of red lozenges along the hoist, the fly charged with two blue horizontal stripes, the figures of the municipal arms of Löptin.
history: Municipal flag of Löptin; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: two blue stripes in the fly
